title: PL1-5 Visual Object / Material Budget

material_policy.rule: Fallbacks reuse shared material catalog where possible; final GLBs should share atlas/material families where practical.

mobile_policy.low: decorative props cull before semantic POIs/harbor landmarks
mobile_policy.high: same semantic truth; only visual density/visibility may increase

reason: Current PL1-5 repeated counts are still small; introducing MultiMesh without native profiling could worsen coarse culling and replacement flexibility.
